seller_or_subject: Seller reports 5 months of non-payment including all Christmas revenue (OUT OF WINDOW — June 2020)
what: Seller Tania Ramírez reports 5 consecutive months of non-payment by Kichink, including all December (highest-sales month) and January revenue.
verbatim_snippet: "Oficialmente ya son 5 meses de retraso que @Kichink no me paga, se quedo con todas mis ventas Navideñas (Diciembre el mes que vendí más) y todas las de Enero. Que INJUSTICIA, @KichinkNoPaga @KichinkAyuda @Profeco @AristeguiOnline #KichinkNoPaga"
notes: OUT OF WINDOW. Seller: @TaniaaMontano (Tania Ramírez). Tweet embedded in MarketHax article. December described as highest-sales month. Original tweet may no longer be directly accessible. Source (MarketHax) directly accessed and verified.
